data.case_title: Refusal of sidewalk permit for café tables and chairs
data.explanation: The Bezirksamt (district office) has refused the special-use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) you requested for two tables and four chairs outside your café, because the sidewalk is too narrow there to leave the required 1.50 m clear for pedestrians. You may decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to this refusal, and the app shows until when you can do so. Alternatively, the letter says a permit for just one table against the house wall would likely be possible with a new informal application. If you do nothing, this refusal stands.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the permit refusal
items.action: If you disagree with the refusal, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Bezirksamt Musterwerder, or consider submitting a new informal application for a single table against the house wall instead.
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterwerder (Fachamt Management des öffentlichen Raumes) refused Lavinia Beispielfleet's request for a special-use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) to place two tables and four chairs on the sidewalk in front of Kanalstraße 70 for her café, because the sidewalk is only 2.10 m wide and would leave less than the required 1.50 m clear for pedestrians. A permit for a single table against the house wall could be possible with a new informal application.
data.title: Refusal of sidewalk permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) for café tables
